title: Automated environment health assertions for private deployments (quotas/IAM/DNS/GPU)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an automated assertion suite that runs as part of Private (VPC) deployment pipelines and as a standalone validator. The suite will validate critical environment prerequisites: cloud quota availability (CPUs, GPUs, IPs), IAM permissions and policy simulation for the installer role, DNS resolution for internal hostnames and egress endpoints, and GPU SKU capacity/availability across target regions/Zones. The goal is to surface actionable, machine-readable errors early in onboarding and upgrades so customers and SEs can remediate before a failed install.
acceptance_criteria: A CLI / Terraform provider integration 'redwood-verify' runs as part of CI and returns nonzero on failed assertions

Checks include: quota thresholds with per-sku breakdown, IAM permission simulation for installer principals, DNS lookups for control-plane and data-plane domains, and per-zone GPU SKU availability checks
Each failed assertion emits a structured JSON report with remediation steps and estimated corrective commands
Integrates into existing Terraform modules so that users see warnings during 'terraform plan' and failing conditions when explicitly invoked
Metrics emitted to the console and the observability pipeline (check latency, pass/fail) and a dashboard tile in Console for recent preinstall runs
End-to-end smoke test demonstrating detection of an artificially reduced GPU quota and blocked DNS resolution
technical_approach: Build a small Go binary 'redwood-verify' that wraps provider APIs (AWS/GCP/Azure) for quota and capacity checks and uses cloud SDKs for IAM simulatePrincipalPolicy
Add a Terraform null_resource + local-exec hook and a lightweight Terraform provider extension to expose checks as data sources so plan-time feedback is possible
DNS checks use a configurable resolver list and perform A/AAAA/CNAME lookups and synthetic HTTP/TLS probes for egress endpoints
GPU availability uses two-stage strategy: 1) quota + SKU listing via provider APIs, 2) optional ephemeral instance launch in a dry-run mode to validate real-world allocation (opt-in flag due to cost)
Report format: newline-delimited JSON objects with keys: check_id, severity, message, remediation, region, metadata
Include a permissive runtime flag to skip non-blocking checks and an explicit --require-all flag for CI gating
rollout_plan: Spike + prototype in a feature branch that implements AWS path only (2 sprints)
Add Terraform integration and a 'verify' target in the private-deploy repo for manual runs
Add GCP and Azure implementations and expand test matrix in CI
Create Console dashboard tile and define Alerting rules for repeated failures
Ship initial beta as opt-in for Dedicated/Private customers, gather feedback, iterate
test_plan: Unit tests for cloud API wrappers and IAM simulation parsing
Integration tests against mocked provider endpoints (localstack / gcp-mock) in CI
E2E smoke test job that reduces a test account GPU quota and asserts detection
DNS failure simulation job that changes resolver behavior and validates error messages
Manual verification run during a staging Private install and validation by Solutions Engineering
